description: Des Moines, IA – The Hinson Campaign released the following statement correcting the record on Ashley Hinson’s family finances. “Ashley and her husband, Matt, sold her individual publicly traded stocks shortly after taking office and do not trade stocks. In fact, Ashley voted to ban members of Congress from trading stocks––the only reasons that bill isn’t law today are the Senate Democrats who voted against it.” – Billy Fuerst, Campaign Communications Director Background: ###

title: Get the Facts on Ashley Hinson’s Family Finances, Record of Cleaning Up Washington - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
